title: 第7章 抵达海牙港第8章 法术与艰苦的航行
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 罗德跟着喊了一嗓子。
却并未立刻动身。
“出发暂且不急。”
“黑滩镇贫瘠…所以我额外准备了些物资…”
他话音刚落，伴随着一声声水手的呼喊和船笛响起。
在河道内等待的32艘柯克船与6艘平底驳船按照泊位和次序分批驶入刚空出的码头。
这就是罗德给自己张罗的安家费。
这些船有一部分是从上游调集来的。
其内装载的物资也多是如此。
在卡林城这里筹措的物资大约只占了五分之二。
这一幕让拜伦伯爵嘴巴微张。
向来运筹帷幄的他，第一次在儿子面前露出了惊容。
码头边围观的那些家伙也都是惊掉下巴的表情。
虽然拜伦伯爵一直都知道罗德在黑街捣鼓了一些工坊。
但在他眼里，此举就跟小孩子过家家差不多。
而且跟黑街老鼠混在一起，多少有些不够体面。
他还从未想过，外城黑街竟能撬动出如此大的利益！
“罗德…这…”
却见罗德微笑说道。
“父亲大人，有时老鼠们也是能搬动大象的。”
是夜。
月河泛起了银白光芒。
如同一条蜿蜒的匹练，顺着陆地延伸到海中。
罗德的船队平稳的顺河而下。
预计在清晨时分就能抵达海牙港。
索拉斯大陆的造船技术还算比较发达。
据他所知，海上已经有媲美卡拉克船的大型货船了。
这些大型的海船通常都会装配附魔的船首像。
船体本身也经过了符文强化。
虽然这个世界的超凡力量还未全面下沉至民间。
但在军事、航运等领域都有较为广泛的运用。
罗德倚靠在船首的护栏旁，望着河面上的波光。
“老爷，您该休息了。”
贴身男仆托马斯手捧他的外套主动提醒道。
却见罗德摆了摆手。
“你先去睡吧。”
“我这里暂时不用伺候。”
闻言，托马斯迟疑了片刻还是躬身离开。
content_en:
;;
Rhodes shouted.
But he didn't leave immediately.
"There's no rush to leave now."
"Black Beach Town is barren...so I prepared some extra supplies..."
As soon as he finished speaking, there were shouts from sailors and the sound of the ship's whistle.
The 32 Kirk boats and 6 flat-bottomed barges waiting in the river entered the newly vacated dock in batches according to their berths and order.
This is the settlement fee that Rhodes paid for himself.
Some of these ships were mobilized from upstream.
There are also many supplies loaded in it.
Only about two-fifths of the supplies raised in Carlin City were taken up.
This scene made Earl Byron open his mouth slightly.
He, who has always been a strategist, showed a surprised look in front of his son for the first time.
The guys watching at the dock also had jaw-dropping expressions.
Although Earl Byron has always known that Rhodes worked on some workshops on the black street.
But in his eyes, this move is almost like a child playing house.
And hanging out with the gangster rats was somewhat unseemly.
He had never thought that the black streets in the outer city could generate such huge profits!
"Rhode...this..."
But Rhodes smiled and said.
"Father, sometimes mice can move elephants."
…
It's night.
The moon river glowed with silvery white light.
Like a winding chain, it extends from the land to the sea.
Rhodes' fleet sailed smoothly down the river.
Expect to arrive at The Hague Port in the early morning.
The shipbuilding technology in Solas Continent is relatively advanced.
As far as he knew, there were already large cargo ships on the sea that were comparable to the Karak ship.
These large sea vessels are often equipped with enchanted prow images.
The hull itself has also been rune-fortified.
Although the extraordinary power of this world has not yet fully reached the people.
However, it is widely used in military, shipping and other fields.
Rhodes leaned against the guardrail of the bow and looked at the waves on the river.
"Master, it's time for you to rest."
Thomas, the valet, reminded him proactively, holding his coat in his hand.
But Rhodes waved his hand.
"You go to bed first."
"I don't need to serve you here for the time being."
Hearing this, Thomas hesitated for a moment before bowing and leaving.
